# Reach Orion

> Next-Generation Headless CMS Platforms, Digital Architecture & SaaS MVP Studio.

Reach Orion is an IT development studio delivering custom headless CMS platforms, websites, and SaaS MVPs. We replace brittle monolithic templates with clean, decoupled architecture: fast to launch, simple to manage, and engineered to scale.

## Core Capabilities
- **Websites & Editorial Platforms**: Sanity.io, Payload CMS 3.0, Next.js App Router, React 18. Fast, SEO + AIO-ready with <0.9s LCP.
- **SaaS MVPs & App Frontends**: Rapid sprint delivery from validated idea to first paying users in weeks.
- **CMS Migration & Decoupled Architecture**: Zero-downtime migration from legacy WordPress/Drupal to headless architectures.
- **Ongoing Architecture Maintenance**: Retainers with 99.9% uptime SLA, security monitoring, and continuous performance tuning.

## Performance Benchmarks
- **Lighthouse Core Web Vitals**: 90+
- **Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)**: <0.9s
- **Time to First Byte (TTFB)**: <400ms
- **Hosting Uptime**: 99.9%

## Pricing & Packages (USD / INR)
- **Essential Foundation**: From $600 / ₹50,000 (Fast, lightweight headless setup for MVPs and single-market sites)
- **Flagship Decoupled Platform**: From $1,500 / ₹1,25,000 (Multi-market editorial, custom component system, sub-second LCP)
- **Enterprise Re-Architecture**: Custom quote (Zero-downtime migration, SLA coverage, high-scale traffic handling)
